title: RNArrow — RNTuple Arrow Gateway
description: A C++ library and Arrow Flight gRPC server that reads CERN ROOT RNTuple physics data files and exposes the data as Apache Arrow — both in-process to Python via pybind11, and over the network through Arrow Flight streaming. It targets the interoperability gap between RNTuple, ROOT's columnar on-disk format, and the wider Apache Arrow ecosystem.
